notes: חֵשֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹה → *for his pleasure* / *Solomon desired*: rectum promoted to subject and realized again as possessive, both to שְׁלֹמֹה headed on the name (rule 25); הָיָה takes *had* and its לְ is unrepresented (rule 43); articles before *his chariots* / *his horsemen* take the possessive standing before their own word (rule 41).
